records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
街のコマンド
街で実行できるコマンドです。建物の看板を選ぶと実行できます。
（都市のみ）と表示されているコマンドは街の規模が「[[145|都市]]」の場合のみ実行できます。
→[[12|酒場]]　→[[21|交易所]]　→[[26|ギルド]]　→[[34|宿屋]]
→[[35|王宮・総督府]]　→[[42|広場]]　→[[44|造船所]]　→[[73|出港所]]→[[144|街データ]]　→[[103|街／洋上共通のコマンド]]
【！】街の[[80|遺跡]]などに行けることもあります。
records.previous_English:
Town Commands 
Select a building's sign to use its 
commands. Commands marked 'City only' are 
available only in a [[145|City.]] See[[12| Tavern,]]
[[21|Market,]][[26| Guild,]][[34| Inn,]]
[[35|Palace or Governor's Office,]][[42| Square,]]
[[44|Shipyard,]][[73| Port,]][[144| City Info]] and
[[103|Shared Commands.]] [!] You may also be able 
to visit local[[80| ruins.]]
records.english: Town Commands Select a building's sign to use its commands. Commands marked 'City only' are available only in a [[145|City.]] See[[12| Tavern,]] [[21|Market,]][[26| Guild,]][[34| Inn,]] [[35|Palace or Governor's Office,]][[42| Square,]] [[44|Shipyard,]][[73| Port,]][[144| City Info]] and [[103|Shared Commands.]] [!] You may also be able to visit local[[80| ruins.]]
records.localization_note: Town Commands names the Tavern and gives the intended building and City-only navigation.
records.source_meaning: Use buildings’ signs for town commands. City-only commands require City status. The original links list the main buildings and other town options, including ruins.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
酒場
水夫の募集、情報収集などを行います。
【！】アラブ文化圏は宗教上の理由から酒場のない街が多く、水夫を集めにくいので、うかつに戦闘を仕掛けるのは危険です。
→[[13|飲み物をたのむ]]　→[[14|みんなにおごる]]
→[[15|水夫を集める]]　→[[16|策謀の立案]]
records.previous_English:
Tavern
Recruit sailors and gather information. 
[!] Many towns in Arab cultural regions 
have no tavern for religious reasons, 
making it harder to recruit sailors. Be 
careful about starting battles there. See 
[[13|Order Drink,]][[14| Treat Everyone,]]
[[15|Recruit Sailors]] and[[16| Plot.]]
records.heading: Tavern
records.english: Recruit crew and gather news at the Tavern. Many towns in Arab cultural regions have no tavern for religious reasons. It's harder to find sailors there, so think twice before starting a battle. See [[13|Order Drink,]] [[14|Treat Everyone,]] [[15|Recruit Crew,]] and [[16|Schemes.]]
records.localization_note: Keep the regional and religious context, the advice about battle and all four original menu links.
semantic_sections: Recruit crew and gather news at the Tavern. Many towns in Arab cultural regions have no tavern for religious reasons. It's harder to find sailors there, so think twice before starting a battle. See [[13|Order Drink,]] [[14|Treat Everyone,]] [[15|Recruit Crew,]] and [[16|Schemes.]]
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Tavern
Recruit crew and gather news at the
Tavern. Many towns in
Arab cultural regions have no tavern for
religious reasons. It's harder to find
sailors there, so think twice before
starting a battle. See Order Drink,
Treat Everyone, Recruit Crew, and
Schemes.

records.source_meaning: Recruit sailors and gather information at the Tavern. Religious restrictions leave many towns in Arab cultural regions without a tavern, so replacement sailors are harder to find and battles are risky.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
飲み物をたのむ（酒場）
飲み物をたのみます。金貨５～10枚が必要です。近辺にある街の情報や、他勢力の情報を聞けることがあります。
【！】[[145|都市]]の酒場には、話相手をしてくれる女性がいます。情報通の彼女たちとは、積極的に話をしてみましょう。アイテムのありかが分かることも…。
records.previous_English:
Order Drink (Tavern)
A drink costs 5 to 10 gold coins. You may 
hear news about nearby towns or other 
factions. [!] Talk with the well-informed 
women at taverns in [[145|Cities.]] They may even
know where to find an item.
records.english: Order Drink (Tavern) A drink costs 5 to 10 gold coins. You may hear news about nearby towns or other factions. [!] Talk with the well-informed women at taverns in [[145|Cities.]] They may even know where to find an item.
records.localization_note: The price and two news topics read clearly, and the City link and the women’s item tips carry their source meaning.
records.source_meaning: Order a drink for 5 to 10 gold to learn about nearby towns and other factions. Women at city taverns are knowledgeable and may reveal an item’s whereabouts.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
みんなにおごる（酒場）
酒場で飲む人々に飲み物をおごります。
近くの街の情報や、他勢力の情報を聞けます。水夫を集める前に実行すると、水夫が集まりやすくなります。
また、アイテムの情報を教えてくれる
ことも…。
→[[15|水夫を集める]]
records.previous_English:
Treat Everyone (Tavern) 
Buy drinks for everyone in the tavern.
You can hear news about nearby towns and
other factions, and you may learn about 
items. Doing this before you
[[15|Recruit Sailors]] makes it easier to 
attract a crew.
records.heading: Treat Everyone (Tavern)
records.english: Buy a round for everyone in the Tavern. You'll hear news about nearby towns and other factions, and you may get a tip about an item. Buying a round before you choose [[15|Recruit Crew]] makes it easier to find sailors.
records.localization_note: Use the current menu name. Buying a round preserves the sense of treating the room, including its recruiting benefit.
semantic_sections: Buy a round for everyone in the Tavern. You'll hear news about nearby towns and other factions, and you may get a tip about an item. Buying a round before you choose [[15|Recruit Crew]] makes it easier to find sailors.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Treat Everyone (Tavern)
Buy a round for everyone in the Tavern.
You'll hear news about nearby towns and
other factions, and you may get a tip
about an item. Buying a round before you
choose Recruit Crew makes it easier to
find sailors.

records.source_meaning: Buy drinks for the room. Hear about towns and other factions and sometimes items. Treating everyone before recruiting improves turnout.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
水夫を集める（酒場）
船に乗せる水夫を募集します。
街の発展度が高いほど一度に多く集まりますが、金貨がたくさん必要です。必要以上に集まった場合、その場で解雇します。
集める前に飲み物をふるまうと、集まりやすくなります。
水夫が集まったら、[[139|水夫編成]]で艦隊の各船に割り当てます。
records.previous_English:
Recruit Sailors (Tavern)
Recruit sailors for your ships. Towns 
with higher Growth offer more sailors at
once, but hiring them costs more gold.
Excess recruits are dismissed on the
spot. Treating everyone to drinks 
beforehand helps. Then use[[139| Assign Sailors]]
to distribute them among your fleet's 
ships.
records.heading: Recruit Crew (Tavern)
records.english: Recruit sailors for your fleet. Towns with higher Growth offer more recruits at once, but the fee is higher. Any extra recruits are dismissed on the spot. Buy a round first to improve turnout. Then use [[139|Assign Sailors]] to place the new recruits on your ships.
records.localization_note: Use the original English menu names for recruitment and assignment. Keep the cost, turnout and dismissal rules.
semantic_sections: Recruit sailors for your fleet. Towns with higher Growth offer more recruits at once, but the fee is higher. Any extra recruits are dismissed on the spot. Buy a round first to improve turnout. Then use [[139|Assign Sailors]] to place the new recruits on your ships.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Recruit Crew (Tavern)
Recruit sailors for your fleet. Towns
with higher Growth offer more recruits at
once, but the fee is higher. Any extra
recruits are dismissed on the spot. Buy a
round first to improve turnout. Then use
Assign Sailors to place the new recruits
on your ships.

records.source_meaning: Recruit sailors for your ships. More developed towns attract more at once and cost more to recruit in. Dismiss extras on the spot. Treating the room helps turnout. Assign recruits to individual ships afterward.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
策謀の立案（酒場）
他の勢力に策略を仕掛けます。
[[118|参謀]]がひらめいたときのみ実行できます。
金貨1000枚が必要です。失敗もあります。
他の勢力がいない海域では、実行できません。「偽文書制作」以外の策略は、他勢力の[[150|シェア]]がある街に行ったことがある場合のみ実行できます。
→[[17|艦隊誘導]]　→[[18|偽文書制作]]　→[[19|悪い噂]]　→[[20|買収]]
records.previous_English:
Plot (Tavern) 
Plan a scheme against another faction.
You can do this only when your[[118| Strategist]]
has an idea. It costs 1,000 gold coins, 
and the plan may fail. You cannot use it
in a sea region with no other factions. 
Except for Bogus Documents, you must have 
visited a town where another faction has
[[150|Market Share.]] See[[17| Lure Fleets,]]
[[18|Bogus Documents,]][[19| Bad Rumors]] and[[20| Bribery.]]
records.heading: Schemes (Tavern)
records.english: If your [[118|Strategist]] has an idea, you can scheme against a rival. Each attempt costs 1,000 gold and can fail. You need another faction in this region. Except for Forge Papers, you must have visited a town where another faction has [[150|market share.]] See [[17|Lure Fleet,]] [[18|Forge Papers,]] [[19|Bad Rumors,]] and [[20|Bribe.]]
records.localization_note: Use the original action names and keep the 1,000-gold cost, possible failure and Forge Papers exception.
semantic_sections: If your [[118|Strategist]] has an idea, you can scheme against a rival. Each attempt costs 1,000 gold and can fail. You need another faction in this region. Except for Forge Papers, you must have visited a town where another faction has [[150|market share.]] See [[17|Lure Fleet,]] [[18|Forge Papers,]] [[19|Bad Rumors,]] and [[20|Bribe.]]
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Schemes (Tavern)
If your Strategist has an idea, you can
scheme against a rival. Each attempt
costs 1,000 gold and can fail. You need
another faction in this region. Except
for Forge Papers, you must have visited a
town where another faction has
market share. See Lure Fleet,

records.source_meaning: A Strategist’s idea enables a scheme against another faction. It costs 1,000 gold and can fail. Another faction is required locally. Except for forged documents, you must have visited a town where a rival holds market share.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
艦隊誘導（酒場→策謀の立案）
他勢力の艦隊を指定した街におびき寄せます。誘導先の街を海域内から１つ選びます。
records.previous_English:
Lure fleets 
Draw a rival fleet to a chosen city in
the current sea region.
records.heading: Lure Fleet
records.english: Draw another faction's fleet to a town you choose in the current sea region.
records.localization_note: The action and the target are singular. Town preserves the broader Japanese settlement term.
semantic_sections: Draw another faction's fleet to a town you choose in the current sea region.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Lure Fleet
Draw another faction's fleet to a town
you choose in the current sea region.

records.source_meaning: Lure another faction’s fleet toward a chosen town in the current sea region.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
偽文書制作（酒場→策謀の立案）
他勢力が複数ある場合に、２つの勢力を敵対させる文面の偽文書を作ります。敵対させる勢力を２つ選びます。
records.previous_English:
Bogus Documents 
Forge documents to turn two other 
factions against each other. You can use
this scheme only if there are at least
two other factions. Select the two
factions you want to make hostile to one
another.
records.heading: Forge Papers
records.english: Choose two other factions and forge papers to turn them against each other. You need at least two other factions to use this scheme.
records.localization_note: Use the original menu name and keep the need for two other factions and the specific purpose of the papers.
semantic_sections: Choose two other factions and forge papers to turn them against each other. You need at least two other factions to use this scheme.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Forge Papers
Choose two other factions and forge
papers to turn them against each other.
You need at least two other factions to
use this scheme.

records.source_meaning: When there are multiple other factions, choose two and create forged documents to turn them hostile toward each other.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
悪い噂（酒場→策謀の立案）
他勢力の悪評を街に流します。悪評を流す街を海域内から１つ選びます。
悪評を流すと、その街における相手勢力のシェアが下がります。
参謀の能力が低いと、ひらめきません。
records.previous_English:
Bad Rumors
Spread bad rumors about another faction 
in a town you choose within the current 
sea region. This reduces that faction's 
market share there. Your strategist will
not think of this scheme if their ability 
is too low.
records.heading: Bad Rumors
records.english: Spread damaging rumors about another faction in a town in the current sea region. This lowers that faction's market share there. Your Strategist must be skilled enough to think of this scheme.
records.localization_note: Name the market-share loss and keep the Strategist prerequisite without implying a numeric threshold.
semantic_sections: Spread damaging rumors about another faction in a town in the current sea region. This lowers that faction's market share there. Your Strategist must be skilled enough to think of this scheme.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Bad Rumors
Spread damaging rumors about another
faction in a town in the current
sea region. This lowers that faction's
market share there. Your Strategist must
be skilled enough to think of this
scheme.

records.source_meaning: Choose one town in the region and spread damaging rumors there. It reduces the target faction’s local share. A Strategist with insufficient ability will not come up with the plan.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
買収（酒場→策謀の立案）
他勢力がいる街で仲介人を買収し、他勢力のシェアを奪います。買収する街を海域内から１つ選びます。
参謀の能力が低いと、ひらめきません。
records.previous_English:
Bribery 
Bribe a broker in a town where another
faction operates to take some of its
market share. Choose one town in the
current sea region. Your strategist will
not think of this scheme if their ability 
is too low.
records.heading: Bribe
records.english: Choose a town in the current sea region where another faction operates. Bribe a broker there to take some of that faction's market share. Your Strategist must be skilled enough to think of this scheme.
records.localization_note: Match Bribe and make the original town, broker, faction and market-share relationship clear.
semantic_sections: Choose a town in the current sea region where another faction operates. Bribe a broker there to take some of that faction's market share. Your Strategist must be skilled enough to think of this scheme.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Bribe
Choose a town in the current sea region
where another faction operates. Bribe a
broker there to take some of that

records.source_meaning: Choose a town in the current sea region where a rival holds share. Bribe a local broker to take some of that faction’s share. The Strategist needs sufficient ability to think of this plan.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
参謀室（共通コマンド→甲板画面）
参謀が策略を練る部屋です。
配置した航海士は「参謀」になります。配置できるのは、謀略術 120以上の航海士です。
参謀がひらめくと、酒場で「[[16|策謀の立案]]」を実行できます。敵の策謀を未然に防いでくれることもあります。宿屋に泊まると、他勢力の情報を入手してきます。
records.previous_English:
Tactics Room
Officers assigned here become Strategists 
and need Guile 120 or higher. When your 
Strategist has an idea, you can choose
[[16|Plot]] at the Tavern. They may also stop
enemy schemes before they happen. When
you stay at an Inn, they gather 
information about other factions.
records.heading: Tactics Room
records.english: Strategists plan your schemes here. An officer needs Guile 120 or higher to take the job. When your Strategist has an idea, choose [[16|Schemes]] at the Tavern. They may foil enemy schemes. They also gather news about other factions when you stay at an Inn.
records.localization_note: Use Schemes where it links back to the Tavern, and keep the separate plan, defense and intelligence duties.
semantic_sections: Strategists plan your schemes here. An officer needs Guile 120 or higher to take the job. When your Strategist has an idea, choose [[16|Schemes]] at the Tavern. They may foil enemy schemes. They also gather news about other factions when you stay at an Inn.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

visible_lines: Tactics Room
Strategists plan your schemes here. An
officer needs Guile 120 or higher to take
the job. When your Strategist has an
idea, choose Schemes at the Tavern. They
may foil enemy schemes. They also gather
news about other factions when you stay
at an Inn.

records.source_meaning: The Tactics Room houses a Strategist with Guile of at least 120. An idea unlocks Tavern schemes. The officer can foil enemy plans and obtains information about other factions when the crew stays at an Inn.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Tavern Help and its linked Tactics Room and crew assignment pages.
records.source_Japanese:
水夫編成（共通コマンド）
水夫を船に配置します。
水夫の「必要数／現在数／最大数」が各船に表示されます。十字ボタンの左右で船ごとに現在数を増減します。自動で一括編成することもできます。
必要数より水夫が少ないと船が遅くなります。
［旗艦重視］旗艦へ優先的に配置。
［平均化］最大数に対する割合を均等に配置。［必要最小］必要数のみを配置。
records.previous_English:
Assign Sailors
Distribute sailors among your ships. Each 
ship shows Need, Now and Max: required, 
current and maximum crew. 
Press Left or Right to adjust a ship's
current crew, or press Y for Auto. Ships
below Need sail more slowly.
[[210|Continue reading]]

current_continuations.previous_English:
Assign Sailors (continued)
Auto offers three policies: Flagship
gives priority to the flagship; Even
assigns the same percentage of maximum
crew to each ship; Minimum assigns only 
the required crew.
[[139|Back to article start]]

records.english: Assign Sailors Distribute sailors among your ships. Each ship shows Need, Now and Max: required, current and maximum crew. Press Left or Right to adjust a ship's current crew, or press Y for Auto. Ships below Need sail more slowly. [[210|Continue reading]] Assign Sailors (continued) Auto offers three policies: Flagship gives priority to the flagship; Even assigns the same percentage of maximum crew to each ship; Minimum assigns only the required crew. [[139|Back to article start]]
records.localization_note: Assign Sailors uses the current heading and keeps the displayed count fields, controls and three policies on its linked pages.
records.source_meaning: Assign sailors to ships. Need, Now and Max are displayed. Left and Right change the current count, and Auto offers priority to the flagship, equal ratios or minimum staffing. Ships short of required crew sail more slowly.
